Synergy Pharmaceuticals Inc. (SGYP) Reaches $1.49 Yearly Low; Harris Associates LP Raised Its Liberty Global Plc (LBTYA) Holding
May 2, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Harris Associates LP increased Liberty Global Plc (LBTYA) stake by 55.74% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Harris Associates LP acquired 6.32M shares as Liberty Global Plc (LBTYA)’s stock declined 8.90%. The Harris Associates LP holds 17.65M shares with $632.65 million value, up from 11.33 million last quarter. Liberty Global Plc now has $23.17B valuation. The stock decreased 0.70% or $0.21 $29.67. About 112,644 shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYA) has declined 8.85% downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.40% the S&P500.
The stock of Synergy Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ:SGYP) hit a new 52-week low and has $1.42 target or 5.00% below today’s $1.49 share price. The 5 months bearish chart indicates high risk for the $367.52M company. The 1-year low was reported on May, 2 by Barchart.com . If the $1.42 price target is reached, the company will be worth $18.38 million less. It closed at $1.49 lastly. It is down 62.55% downtrending. It has underperformed by 74.10% the S&P500.
Harris Associates LP decreased Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) stake by 17,865 shares to 3.68M valued at $623.58 million in 2017Q4. It also reduced Foot Locker Inc (NYSE:FL) stake by 1.76 million shares and now owns 4.20M shares. News Corp New (NASDAQ:NWSA) was reduced too.

Wunderlich maintained Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYA) on Monday, January 25 with “Buy” rating.
Analysts await Synergy Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ:SGYP) to report earnings on May, 9. They expect $-0.16 earnings per share, up 46.67% or $0.14 from last year’s $-0.3 per share. After $-0.18 actual earnings per share reported by Synergy Pharmaceuticals Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -11.11% EPS growth.
Synergy Pharmaceuticals Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development and commercialization of novel therapies to treat gastrointestinal diseases and disorders. The company has market cap of $367.52 million. The Company’s lead product is plecanatide, a novel uroguanylin analog that is traded under the TRULANCE name for the treatment of chronic idiopathic constipation and irritable bowel syndrome. It currently has negative earnings. The firm also develops dolcanatide to treat mild-to-moderate ulcerative colitis.
